description: Use when the user asks: 'what's new in the directory mcp', 'what changed in the directory', 'directory release notes', 'what version is the directory on'. Returns recent releases of the PICA directory MCP server — what shipped in the public catalogue surface itself. NOT for catalogue content searches (use directory_search / directory_list_works / directory_chain for those). Returns { package, current_version, releases: [{ version, date, sections, markdown }], resource_uri }. Defaults to the last 3 releases; use `since_version` to bound the output or `sections` to filter to Added/Fixed/etc. → then: directory_search (explore anything a release note mentions)

limit.description: Maximum number of releases to return. Default 3, max 20.

sections.description: Filter each release's sections to only these names (e.g. ['Added', 'Fixed']). Sections not in the list are omitted from output.

since_version.description: If set, returns only releases strictly greater than this version (semver-compared). Versions equal to since_version are excluded.

name: directory_release_notes
title: Release notes
